target_statement: For \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\), \(\ell\ge0\), let \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I_n-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), \(\mu\) be normalized full real orthogonal Haar, \(\nu_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\), \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), \(P_\pm=\nu_\pm\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\gamma\), and \(p_O(x)=\frac{\sqrt{\det A_O}}{(2\pi)^{n/2}}e^{-x^\top A_Ox/2}\) on Euclidean volume. Set \(t(x)=e^{-\ell\|x\|^2}\) and \(H(\ell)=\int\det(O)\int t(x)p_O(x)\,dx\,d\mu(O)\). Then \(2|H(\ell)|\le\sup_{B\ \mathrm{measurable}}|P_+(B)-P_-(B)|\). Includes zero tilt; all actual law, probability, L1 and supremum conditions are internal.
